name: ptolemy-copernicus-newton
description: Interactive 2D orrery comparing the Ptolemaic, Copernican and Newtonian models of the solar system.
author: Richard Lipka

scripts.//scripts: The trailing `--` matters: without it npm appends any extra arguments bare, so `npm run dev -- --port 5180` reaches the inner script as npm config flags and the port is silently ignored.
